acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Per sample, 10 µg protein was subjected to reduction and alkylation (12 mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine, 40 mM 2-chloroacetamide for 1 h at 25 °C) and desalting performed according to the SP3 protocol.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Per sample, 10 µg protein was subjected to reduction and alkylation (12 mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine, 40 mM 2-chloroacetamide for 1 h at 25 °C) and desalting performed according to the SP3 protocol.

cleavage_agent.evidence: The pellets were resuspended within 50 mM TEAB buffer (pH 8.5) with 0.2 µg trypsin (1:50 enzyme to protein ratio, Promega, Madison, WI, USA), incubated for 16 h at 37 °C, and the supernatants were acidified using trifluoroacetic acid (TFA) for LC-MS/MS measurement.

collision_energy.evidence: Full scan MS spectra were acquired between 300 and 1800 m/z at a resolution of 70,000 at m/z 200, and top ten most intense precursor ions were selected for MS/MS analysis (charge state: ≥+2, isolation window: ±1.5 m/z, HCD fragmentation: 27 NCE).

fragmentation_method.evidence: Full scan MS spectra were acquired between 300 and 1800 m/z at a resolution of 70,000 at m/z 200, and top ten most intense precursor ions were selected for MS/MS analysis (charge state: ≥+2, isolation window: ±1.5 m/z, HCD fragmentation: 27 NCE).

instrument.evidence: Samples were injected in triplicate on a Dionex Ultimate 3000 nano-UHPLC coupled to a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: A spray voltage of 1.5 kV was applied via a liquid junction emitter (MS Wil Fused silica emitter, CoAnn Technologies LLC, Richland, WA, USA), with a source temperature of 250 °C.

labeling.evidence: Label-free quantification was performed by a Minora feature detector with a subsequent feature mapper (minimum trace length: 5; maximum RT shift: 4 min; mass tolerance: 10 ppm; parameter tuning: fine).

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: Samples were injected in triplicate on a Dionex Ultimate 3000 nano-UHPLC coupled to a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
